headline: You’re losing money by increasing size after a loss

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: Sizing up after a loss cost you ₹1,05,732. Those after‑loss trades produced ₹1,95,375 loss with a win rate of 28% versus 39% otherwise, and the entry size was 1.91x larger.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Averaging down is worth watching as it may be influencing your performance.

closing: Try to follow the rule “After a loss, your next entry is your usual size” next month.
